description: Pointer callout: a pulsing target dot (or a self-drawing highlight box with optional spotlight dimming) connected by an animated elbow leader line to a label pill. Transparent background.

params.x: Target X as a fraction of the frame width (0–1), default 0.62
params.y: Target Y as a fraction of the frame height (0–1), default 0.42
params.box: Optional highlight box 'x,y,w,h' in frame fractions (e.g. '0.55,0.3,0.25,0.2'); when set the leader starts at the box edge
params.spotlight: 'true' to dim everything outside the box (default true when box is set)
params.accent: Accent colour for line, dot, box and pill (hex), default #FFD43B
params.textColor: Label text colour; default auto (dark on light accents, white on dark)
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output, default #0B0B10
